headline: M&A drives revenue lift; FCF turns positive
summary_short: Q2 2026 revenue €437.3M (+18% y/y). M&A drove most of the growth — organic 4%. Net income €47.3M (+14% y/y). FCF flipped positive at €14.6M vs -€16.7M Q2 2025.
summary_long: Topicus.com posted Q2 2026 revenue of €437.3M, +18% y/y, of which organic growth was 4% and M&A contributed the balance. Net income €47.3M (+14% y/y) vs €41.5M in Q2 2025. Free cash flow to shareholders swung positive: +€14.6M vs -€16.7M in Q2 2025 (+€31.3M improvement). Acquisitions in the quarter carried €40.2M consideration — Topicus's roll-up model continuing at pace. H1 2026 revenue €872.9M (+20% y/y). Reported alongside Constellation Software (majority owner) per standard cross-listed disclosure.
confidence_notes: Organic 4% is on the lower end of Topicus's historical range (typical: 5-8%). M&A is the dominant growth driver — consistent with Constellation's roll-up model. Currency exposure: EUR-reporting VMS in ~40 countries; unhedged EUR/CAD dependency.
